Question 15
?

Calculate ∫(12+4x+12−4x)dx. Assume that K is an arbitrary positive constant.

a
 4ln⁡(K|2+4x2−4x|)
b
14ln⁡(K|2+4x2−4x|)
c
 −14ln⁡(K|2+4x2−4x|)
d
 14ln⁡(K|(2+4x)(2−4x)|)

−4ln⁡(K|(2+4x)(2−4x)|)
